banregio.title: Banregio
items: Design, develop, and maintain Java and Spring Boot microservices supporting digital onboarding processes for banking products, including accounts, credit cards, and insurance.
Design and implement backend application components using Hibernate, JPA, and PostgreSQL, considering integration requirements and dependencies across application components.
Maintain and enhance a biometric authentication application, contributing to both frontend and backend development and integrating new authentication workflows using Incode.
Integrate Elastic Application Performance Monitoring (APM) into Angular applications to support application observability and production monitoring.
Develop and maintain Angular components and pages, implementing new functionality and optimizing existing application features.
Regularly develop unit tests using JUnit and Jest, applying mocking techniques to isolate dependencies and validate application behavior.
Leverage GitHub Copilot to assist with code development, test generation, and development workflows.
Investigate production incidents, perform root cause analysis, document findings, and implement corrective solutions.
Execute and monitor application deployments using OpenShift, collaborating with development and quality assurance teams.
Participate in software development and delivery workflows using GitHub, Jira Cloud, and OpenShift.
